description: Repairs r-sql-13b/agg-sum-boundary: no below-limit Currency group and no per-group isolation. Asks what Field type and value, or error and call, Sum and Avg give for Currency c and Double d per group, each group and aggregate in its own statement: groups 1 to 4 as in r-sql-13b (maximum plus a small value, two maxima, two halves adding to one past the maximum, minimum plus -1) and Currency groups 5 (1, 2), 6 (922337203685477 and 0.5807, adding to the Currency maximum) and 7 (the maximum and 0). Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
